arxiv-1906-07436.title: The Fontaine–Ogus realisation of Laumon 1-motives
arxiv-1906-07436.creator: Nicola Mazzari
arxiv-1906-07436.description: Abstract . We construct the (filtered) Ogus realisation of Laumon 1 1 -motives over a number field. This realisation extends the functor defined on Deligne 1 1 -motives by Andreatta, Barbieri-Viale and Bertapelle. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 14F30, 14L15, 14F40 1.

arxiv-2102-01673.title: Universal systole bounds for arithmetic locally symmetric spaces
arxiv-2102-01673.creator: Sara Lapan, Benjamin Linowitz, Jeffrey S. Meyer
arxiv-2102-01673.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sara Lapan, Benjamin Linowitz, Jeffrey S. Meyer. The systole of a closed Riemannian manifold is the minimal length of a non-contractible closed loop. We give a uniform lower bound for the systole for large classes of simple arithmetic locally symmetric orbifolds. We establish new bounds for the translation length of semisimple x ∈ SL n ⁡ ( 𝐑 ) x\in\SL_{n}(\mathbf{R}) in terms of its associated Mahler measure.

arxiv-2111-11320.title: Private and polynomial time algorithms for learning Gaussians and beyond
arxiv-2111-11320.creator: Hassan Ashtiani, Christopher Liaw
arxiv-2111-11320.description: Abstract We present a fairly general framework for reducing ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) differentially private (DP) statistical estimation to its non-private counterpart. As the main application of this framework, we give a polynomial time and ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) -DP algorithm for learning (unrestricted) Gaussian distributions in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} .

arxiv-2201-04384.title: Magnetic domain wall pinning in cobalt ferrite microstructures Journal: Applied Surface Science
arxiv-2201-04384.creator: Sandra Ruiz-Gómez, Anna Mandziak, Laura Martín-García, José Emilio Prieto, Pilar Prieto, Carmen Munuera, Michael Foerster, Adrián Quesada, Lucía Aballe, Juan de la Figuera
arxiv-2201-04384.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sandra Ruiz-Gómez, Anna Mandziak, Laura Martín-García, José Emilio Prieto, Pilar Prieto, Carmen Munuera, Michael Foerster, Adrián Quesada, Lucía Aballe, Juan de la Figuera. A detailed correlative structural, magnetic and chemical analysis of non-stoichiometric cobalt ferrite micrometric crystals was performed by x-ray magnetic circular dichroism combined with photoemission microscopy, low energy electron microscopy, and atomic force microscopy.

arxiv-2203-16297.title: Forecasting from LiDAR via Future Object Detection
arxiv-2203-16297.creator: Neehar Peri Jonathon Luiten Mengtian Li Aljoša Ošep Laura Leal-Taixé Deva Ramanan
arxiv-2203-16297.description: Abstract Object detection and forecasting are fundamental components of embodied perception. These two problems, however, are largely studied in isolation by the community. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end approach for detection and motion forecasting based on raw sensor measurement as opposed to ground truth tracks.

arxiv-2310-09616.title: Chiral magnetism, lattice dynamics, and anomalous Hall conductivity in the novel V 3 AuN antiferromagnetic antiperovskite
arxiv-2310-09616.creator: J. M. Duran-Pinilla, Aldo H. Romero, A. C. Garcia-Castro
arxiv-2310-09616.description: Abstract Antiferromagnetic antiperovskites, where magnetically active 3 d d metal cations are placed in the octahedral corners of a perovskite structure, are in the spotlight due to their intertwined magnetic structure and topological properties. Especially their anomalous Hall conductivity, which can be controlled by applied strain and/or electric field, makes them highly attractive in different electronic applications.

arxiv-2402-11673.title: Exciton–photocarrier interference in mixed lead-halide-perovskite nanocrystals
arxiv-2402-11673.creator: Esteban Rojas-Gatjens, Quinten A. Akkerman, Liberato Manna, Ajay Ram Srimath Kandada, Carlos Silva-Acuña
arxiv-2402-11673.description: Abstract The use of semiconductor nanocrystals in scalable quantum technologies requires characterization of the exciton coherence dynamics in an ensemble of electronically isolated crystals in which system-bath interactions are nevertheless strong. In this communication, we identify signatures of Fano-like interference between excitons and photocarriers in the coherent two-dimensional photoluminescence excitation spectral lineshapes of mixed lead-halide perovskite nanocrystals in dilute solution.

arxiv-2410-08928.title: Towards Multilingual LLM Evaluation for European Languages
arxiv-2410-08928.creator: Klaudia Thellmann † Michael Fromm † Bernhard Stadler † Jasper Schulze Buschhoff †, Alex Jude Fabio Barth Johannes Leveling Nicolas Flores-Herr Joachim Köhler René Jäkel Mehdi Ali
arxiv-2410-08928.description: Abstract The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized natural language processing across numerous languages and tasks. However, evaluating LLM performance in a consistent and meaningful way across multiple European languages remains challenging, especially due to the scarcity of language-parallel multilingual benchmarks. We introduce a multilingual evaluation approach tailored for European languages.

arxiv-2509-12173.title: Extrapolation of Tempered Posteriors
arxiv-2509-12173.creator: Mengxin Xi, Zheyang Shen, Marina Riabiz, Nicolas Chopin, Chris J. Oates
arxiv-2509-12173.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mengxin Xi, Zheyang Shen, Marina Riabiz, Nicolas Chopin, Chris J. Oates. Tempering is a popular tool in Bayesian computation, being used to transform a posterior distribution p 1 p_{1} into a reference distribution p 0 p_{0} that is more easily approximated. Several algorithms exist that start by approximating p 0 p_{0} and proceed through a sequence of intermediate distributions p t p_{t} until an approximation to p 1 p_{1} is obtained.

arxiv-2511-16729.title: Time Evolution of Multi-Party Entanglement Signals
arxiv-2511-16729.creator: Vijay Balasubramanian, Hanzhi Jiang, and Simon F. Ross
arxiv-2511-16729.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vijay Balasubramanian, Hanzhi Jiang, and Simon F. Ross. We study the real-time dynamics of multi-party entanglement signals in chaotic quantum many-body systems including but not necessarily restricted to holographic conformal field theories. We find that scrambling dynamics generates multiparty entanglement with rich structure including: (a) qualitatively different dynamical behaviours for different signals, likely reflecting different dynamics for different kinds of entanglement patterns, (b) discontinuities indicating dynamical phase transitions in the entanglement structure, (c) transient and non-monotonic multiparty entanglement, and (d) periods during which the

arxiv-2512-21719.title: SiPM-based photodetectors for spectroscopic measurements in wide dynamic range e-mail:Yuri.Kharlov@ihep.ru
arxiv-2512-21719.creator: S. V. Evdokimov +, A. M. Gorin +, V. I. Izucheev +, Y. V. Kharlov +‡, B. V. Polishchuk +, V. I. Rykalin +, S. A. Sadovsky +, A. A. Shangaraev + N. E. Voronkov +, A. A. Zaitsev †
arxiv-2512-21719.description: Abstract Аннотация The results of measurements of the characteristics of photodetectors based on large-area SiPM matrices with a wide dynamic range are presented. The potential application of SiPM-based photodetectors for electromagnetic calorimetry in the energy range from hundreds of keV to tens of GeV is explored. The potential application of SiPM in gamma-spectroscopy is also discussed.

arxiv-2601-05673.title: Local generation of languages: the monotonic binary sequences
arxiv-2601-05673.creator: Mathieu Hoyrup
arxiv-2601-05673.description: Abstract In a previous article, we have introduced the problem of local generation of languages, where the communication underlying the generation procedure is captured by a simplicial complex. We study in details this problem for the language of binary monotonic sequences. We prove general results and identify several classes of minimal simplicial complexes generating this language.

arxiv-2602-14373.title: Square-bracket operations clubs
arxiv-2602-14373.creator: Osvaldo Guzmán, Stevo Todorcevic
arxiv-2602-14373.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Osvaldo Guzmán, Stevo Todorcevic. This paper continues the investigation of the three square-bracket operations [ ⋅ ⋅ ] [\cdot\cdot] from chapter 5 of [ 40 ] . We say that a square-bracket operation [ ⋅ ⋅ ] [\cdot\cdot] has the Ramsey club property if for every club C ⊆ ω 1 C\subseteq\omega_{1} , there is an uncountable subset W W ⊆ ω 1 \subseteq\omega_{1} such that [ α ​ β ] ∈ C \left[\alpha\beta\right]\in C for every α , β ∈ W .

arxiv-2606-23638.title: Reentrant superconductivity enabled by spin-orbit coupling: Application to UTe 2
arxiv-2606-23638.creator: Changhee Lee, Nico A. Hackner, Daniel F. Agterberg, P. M. R. Brydon

pmc-11350540.title: Factors associated with antibiotic resistance and survival analysis of severe pneumonia patients infected with Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa: A retrospective cohort study in Jakarta, Indonesia
pmc-11350540.creator: Gurmeet Singh, Tonny Loho, Mira Yulianti, Dita Aditianingsih, Laila Fakhriyatuz Zakiyah, Sudirman Fakhruddin Masse, Muhammad Rizki Triono
pmc-11350540.description: Background:Antimicrobial resistance is one of the most significant challenges to global public health and the risk factors in severe pneumonia are constantly growing. Therefore, this study aimed to identify factors associated with antimicrobial resistance and conduct survival analysis of severe pneumonia patients with single and multiple pathogens in the National Referral Hospital, Jakarta, Indonesia.

pmc-11400966.title: Cross-correlation and multifractality analysis of the Chinese and American stock markets based on the MF-DCCA model
pmc-11400966.creator: Yijun Chen, Jun-hao Zhang, Lei Lu, Zi-miao Xie
pmc-11400966.description: ObjectiveTo compare the multifractal features and factors of the Chinese and American stock markets and their correlation, complexity and uncertainty.MethodsThe paper analyzes the CSI 300 and S&P 500 indices from March 2018 to March 2023 using the MF-DCCA model and removes the long-term memory and nonlinear effects by random reshuffling and phase processing methods.

pmc-11417085.title: Changing treatment of hip fractures in Finland
pmc-11417085.creator: Oskari K Leino, Nora Forsbacka, Inari E Laaksonen, Keijo T Mäkelä, Markus Matilainen, Elina M Ekman
pmc-11417085.description: IntroductionHip fracture treatment should be as standardized and effective as possible, with emphasis on fast recovery and avoidance of complications, especially those leading to reoperations. There is accumulating evidence regarding the optimal treatment of hip fractures but reports of whether this has influenced treatment in the clinical setting are sparse.

pmc-11433681.title: Stress-Induced Sulfide Production by Bacillus subtilis and Bacillus megaterium
pmc-11433681.creator: Alexey Tyulenev, Galina Smirnova, Vadim Ushakov, Tatyana Kalashnikova, Lyubov Sutormina, Oleg Oktyabrsky, Juan M Gonzalez
pmc-11433681.description: It was previously discovered that, in the Gram-negative bacterium Escherichia coli growing on a minimal medium with sulfate, stress-induced growth arrest is accompanied by the release of hydrogen sulfide. The source of the sulfide is the desulfurization of intracellular cysteine as one of the ways of maintaining it at a safe level.

pmc-11673830.title: Outlier Handling Strategy of Ensembled-Based Sequential Convolutional Neural Networks for Sleep Stage Classification
pmc-11673830.creator: Wei Zhou, Hangyu Zhu, Wei Chen, Chen Chen, Jun Xu, Richard Bayford, Pietro Aricò
pmc-11673830.description: The pivotal role of sleep has led to extensive research endeavors aimed at automatic sleep stage classification. However, existing methods perform poorly when classifying small groups or individuals, and these results are often considered outliers in terms of overall performance. These outliers may introduce bias during model training, adversely affecting feature selection and diminishing model performance.

pmc-11676756.title: Gingival Margin Damage During Supragingival Dental Polishing by Inexperienced Operator—Pilot Study
pmc-11676756.creator: Blagovesta Yaneva, Petar Shentov, Dimitar Bogoev, Maria Mutafchieva, Stela Atanasova-Vladimirova, Kiril Dimitrov, Diyana Vladova, Angelo Michele Inchingolo, Francesco Inchingolo, Biagio Rapone, Gianna Dipalma, Alessio Danilo Inchingolo, Assunta Patano, Giuseppina Malcangi, Daniele Botticelli
pmc-11676756.description: Background: Supragingival polishing is a crucial part of nonsurgical periodontal therapy. In recent years, air polishing has been used for this purpose, introducing different polishing powders. The purpose of the following study was to investigate the damage to the gingival margin during air polishing by an inexperienced operator.

pmc-12662985.title: Preserving provability over GPU program optimizations with annotation-aware transformations
pmc-12662985.creator: Ömer Şakar, Mohsen Safari, Marieke Huisman, Anton Wijs
pmc-12662985.description: GPU programs are widely used in industry. To obtain the best performance, a typical development process involves the manual or semi-automatic application of optimizations prior to compiling the code. Such optimizations can introduce errors. To avoid the introduction of errors, we can augment GPU programs with (pre- and postcondition-style) annotations to capture functional properties.

pmc-13197329.title: Gender and East–West disparities in German neurosurgical training leadership
pmc-13197329.creator: Aaron Lawson McLean, Anna C Lawson McLean, Christian Senft
pmc-13197329.description: Leadership in neurosurgical training is pivotal for educational quality and workforce development, yet gender and regional disparities remain poorly characterized in Germany. A nationwide cross-sectional study analyzed publicly available data from all 17 state medical chambers. Neurosurgical training program directors (TPDs) were identified, and data were collected on gender, shared training authorizations, and maximum approved training duration.

pmc-13245684.title: Progressive Asymptomatic Hyperglycemia and Glucosuria Identified Through Protocol-Driven Monitoring in a Clinical Trial: A Case Report
pmc-13245684.creator: Raymond T Anasobi, Omar Stewart, Ronald Stumbris
pmc-13245684.description: Severe hyperglycemia may remain clinically silent despite significant metabolic derangement, particularly in patients with inconsistent engagement in care. We report the case of a 50-year-old patient with type 2 diabetes mellitus enrolled in a gout clinical trial, in which protocol-driven laboratory monitoring revealed progressive, asymptomatic hyperglycemia and worsening glucosuria across multiple study visits.

pmc-13272387.title: Habitat suitability for the soybean aphid, Aphis glycines, and its natural enemies: implications for biological control and soybean protection
pmc-13272387.creator: Zhengbing Wang, Mingsheng Yang, Zhen Li, Xin Miao, Jin Liu, Jiahui Zhang, Liuyong Xie, Kedong Xu, Weili Ding, Wu Zhang, Peng Dai, Keshi Ma
pmc-13272387.description: The soybean aphid, Aphis glycines Matsumura, is one of the most destructive pests affecting soybean production, frequently inflicting substantial economic losses. In this study, an optimized MaxEnt model was employed to predict the habitat suitability of A. glycines, its host plant Glycine max, and four key natural enemies (Harmonia axyridis, Chrysopa pallens, Episyrphus balteatus, and Lysiphlebia japonica).

pmc-13491838.title: Exploring the association between menopause and burning mouth syndrome: an updated review
pmc-13491838.creator: Kowsar Qaderi, Farideh Eghdampour, Manthar Ali Mallah, Mehri Kalhor, Hooman Ghasemi, Nima Fallahnia, Zeynab Sohrabi

pmc-13563959.title: Emerging regulatory model of Ubiquitin-Specific Proteases 14 in cancer: from canonical oncogenesis to TME modulation, therapeutic resistance, and non-canonical activities
pmc-13563959.creator: RuoFeng Wang, Fang Yan, Fengrui Duan, Weikai Xia, Wenbo Wang, Zhenxiang Wang, Fulin Sun, Chunjuan Yu, Huhu Zhang, Lina Yang

pmc-13623864.title: Is within-field spatial variation in wheat Fusarium crown rot associated with rhizosphere microbiome and soil nutrients
pmc-13623864.creator: Fei Xu, Greg Deakin, Xiangming Xu
pmc-13623864.description: Fusarium crown rot (FCR) of wheat, caused predominantly by Fusarium pseudograminearum, frequently exhibits marked spatial heterogeneity within individual fields despite uniform cultivars and agronomic management. However, the mechanisms underlying this within-field variation remain poorly understood. In this study, we investigated six commercial wheat fields in Henan Province, China, each containing distinct highly diseased (HD) and lightly diseased (LD) zones.

pmc-13652424.title: First case report of atrial myxoma in interauricular occlusive device in Colombia
pmc-13652424.creator: Isabella Montealegre, Camilo Moreno, Camilo Montes, María F. Mazo, Alex Pava, Andrés Ramos
pmc-13652424.description: Introduction and importance:Primary cardiac tumors are extremely rare; myxomas are the most common benign type in adults. Although percutaneous closure of ostium secundum atrial septal defects (osASD) using occluder devices is a standard and safe procedure, the development of a cardiac mass on these devices is a rare event that requires careful differential diagnosis among thrombi, endocarditis, and neoplasms.

pmc-13678873.title: Pharmacy students’ knowledge and attitudes regarding GLP-1 receptor agonist adverse effects in obesity management: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13678873.creator: Alaa A. Khojah, Malaz J. Gazzaz, Mohammed M. Aldurdunji, Ahmad E. Safiraldeen, Ibrahim R. Al-Qurashi, Mohammad A. Alhazmi, Ashraf N. Abdalla, Roaya S. Alqurashi, Saad M. Wali
pmc-13678873.description: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are important therapeutic options for obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Despite their increasing use, safety concerns remain, and pharmacy students’ knowledge of their adverse effects is unclear. This study evaluated pharmacy students’ knowledge and attitudes regarding GLP-1 RA adverse effects in obesity management.
